desc: A personal Unity puzzle project exploring state-driven gameplay, pixel art, and post-processing.
detail:
A personal Unity puzzle project exploring state-driven gameplay, pixel art, and post-processing.

A personal project built with Unity/C#, DOTween, state machines, post-processing, and an Aseprite pixel-art workflow. Explore the playable version on itch.io.

caseStudy.challenge: Explore puzzle gameplay and visual presentation in a personal Unity project.
contributions: Project stack: Unity/C#, state machines, DOTween, and post-processing.
Pixel-art workflow using Aseprite; a playable version is available on itch.io.
